measurement: tympanic membrane and annulus presence in the holotype description
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype MUSM 31196 (IWU 178), printed as male, SVL 18.9 mm, preserved; one individual. Paratypes as printed (33): 10 adult females MUSM 31977, 31980, 31987, 31201, NMP6V 75076, 75522, 75523, 75528, 75529, 75534; 20 adult males MUSM 31186, 31195, 31199, 31202, 31975, 31979, 31988, 31989, 31992, 31993, NMP6V 75077-75079, 75524-75527, 75533, UMMZ 244726, 244727; 3 juveniles MUSM 31187, 31990, 31200. Methods: specimens fixed in 96% ethanol and stored in 70% ethanol; measurements to the nearest 0.1 mm with digital calipers under a stereomicroscope; the tympanic region of two specimens (MUSM 31199 and NMP6V 75534, both paratypes) was opened to see whether a tympanic annulus is present under the skin, so the holotype itself was not reported as opened. The quote is the head sentence of the holotype description, one cut marked; the cut text covers head proportions, snout, nostrils, canthus, eyelid and the supratympanic fold and none of it qualifies this value. The Diagnosis (a run-in paragraph under Generic placement) lists '(2) tympanic membrane and tympanic annulus absent;', and the Abstract and Comparisons say the same (the species and Phrynopus chaparroi 'lack a tympanum'). Tables 3 and 4 and the Variation section print no tympanum measurement, so text, Diagnosis and tables do not conflict. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

measurement: tympanic membrane and annulus presence in the holotype description
value: tympanic membrane and tympanic annulus absent
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype CORBIDI 20553, printed as adult female (SVL 34.3 mm), preserved; one individual. Paratypes as printed: paratopotypes CORBIDI 20432-20435 and 20436-20439 collected 22 Feb. 2019 (the text counts '3 adult females, 4 adult males' while the figure and Variation text assign 20432-20435 as females and 20436-20439 as males; the count does not match the codes), and CORBIDI 20551, 20552, 20554, 20555-20558 (5 females and 2 males, no individual sexes printed). Methods: specimens preserved in 10% formalin and stored in 70% alcohol; measurements to the nearest 0.1 mm with a digital caliper under a microscope; the Methods do not say how the tympanic region was examined. The quote is the head sentence of the holotype description, one cut marked; the cut text covers head width and length proportions, snout, nostrils, canthus, lips and eyelid and none of it qualifies this value. The Diagnosis lists '(2) tympanic membrane and tympanic annulus absent;' and Comparisons separate the species from P. auriculatus, P. mariellaleo and P. peruanus on this character. Table 1 has no tympanum row (it lists ED only), so text, Diagnosis and table do not conflict; the paratype count mismatch is unrelated to the tympanum. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

measurement: tympanic membrane and annulus condition in the holotype description
value: tympanic membrane present, tympanic annulus weakly defined
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype MUSM 32204 (field number KT 75), printed as adult gravid female, SVL 58.3 mm, preserved; one individual. Paratypes as printed: MUSM 32206 female (KT 76), MUSM 32211 juvenile (KT 84), MUSM 32213 juvenile (KT 72), MUSM 32201 female (KT 89), MUSM 32205 female (KT 87). Methods: specimens fixed in 10% formalin and stored in 70% ethanol; measurements with a Mitutoyo digital caliper to the nearest 0.1 mm; 'Condition of the tympanum was assessed by visual examination under stereoscope.' The quote is the single long head-and-body sentence of the holotype description, with two cuts marked; the cut text covers body, snout, eye, crests (including 'pretympanic crests well defined'), parotoid glands, limbs, skin and tongue measures and none of it qualifies this value. Same sentence: 'tympanum diameter smaller than eye diameter' (no number printed; Table 2 has no tympanum row, only ED 4.4 mm). The Diagnosis prints '(7) tympanic membrane present, tympanic annulus weakly defined;' and the Abstract, Variation and Comparisons agree on presence; the text, Diagnosis and table do not conflict. Only the adult female holotype is described for tympanum condition; juveniles and the other paratypes are not. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

structure: tympanum diameter relative to eye diameter
measurement: tympanum diameter 31% of eye diameter, holotype
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype; the paper prints the proportion in the Description of the holotype
conditions: Holotype CORBIDI 15578, printed as adult male, SVL 21.9 mm; one individual. Paratypes as printed: seven adult male paratopotypes CORBIDI 15563-68 and 15577, and one adult male paratype CORBIDI 16606. Methods: specimens sacrificed with 20% benzocaine, fixed in 10% formalin and stored in 70% ethanol; measurements to the nearest 0.1 mm with digital calipers under a stereoscope; the Methods list no definition of TD. The holotype measurement list prints TD 0.5 mm. The Diagnosis item (2) words the same relation differently, 'horizontal diameter of eye 3x the diameter of tympanum' (about 0.33), a rounded statement that is consistent with 0.31 but is not the same figure. Same sentence: tympanic membrane distinct, differentiated from the surrounding skin; tympanic annulus distinct and round, its upper and posterodorsal edges obscured by a weak supratympanic fold. Table 1 has no TD row and the Variation text gives no tympanum measurement for other specimens. The quote is the holotype-description sentence, with two cuts marked (opening phrase, and the tympanic membrane clause); the cut text does not qualify the ratio. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
